definition_en: to be real or present; to live, especially in difficult conditions; to survive on something
core_image: 一样东西真实地立在那里并持续下去
scene: 问题在于这种鸟是否真的还存在。The question is whether this bird still exists at all.
sceneCN: 这里 exist 是「存在」（第 1 个义项）；句意：问题在于这种鸟是否真的还存在。

derivatives.zh: 存在主义的；关于存在的

senses.title: Be real
senses.definition: to be real or present in the world
senses.definitionCN: 真实地存在于世界上
senses.example: Doubt still exists about the plan.
senses.exampleCN: 人们对这个计划仍有疑虑。
senses.why: The core sense is simply being there.
senses.whyCN: 核心义就是真实地「在那里」。

senses.title: Stay alive
senses.definition: to live, especially in hard conditions
senses.definitionCN: 生存，尤指在艰苦环境中活着
senses.example: These animals exist in the deepest caves.
senses.exampleCN: 这些动物生存在最深的洞穴里。
senses.why: Being present is narrowed to being alive.
senses.whyCN: 「存在」收窄为「活着」。

senses.title: Live on
senses.definition: to manage to live with very little of something
senses.definitionCN: 靠很少的东西勉强维持生活
senses.example: The family existed on rice and beans for a month.
senses.exampleCN: 这家人靠米饭和豆子熬过了一个月。
senses.why: Survival is tied to a small source of support.
senses.whyCN: 生存被具体化为依赖微薄的来源。

intro.en: Exist comes from Latin exsistere, to come forth or appear.
intro.cn: exist 源自拉丁语 exsistere，意为「出现、显现」。

items.en: Exsistere joins ex- (out) with sistere (to stand).
items.cn: exsistere 由 ex-（向外）与 sistere（站立）构成。

items.en: Exsistere means to step out and appear.
items.cn: exsistere 意为迈出并显现。

items.en: Exister carries the sense of being present.
items.cn: exister 带有「在场、存在」的含义。

items.en: Existen names the state of being.
items.cn: existen 指存在的状态。

items.en: Exist covers both being real and staying alive.
items.cn: exist 同时涵盖真实存在与活着。

items.en: Exist on adds the sense of surviving with little.
items.cn: exist on 增加了「靠很少东西生存」之意。

note.en: Exist means to be real; exit is a way out.
note.cn: exist 表示真实存在，exit 则是出口。

entries.definition: a way out of a place

normalIntro.en: Exist is about being real or staying alive.
normalIntro.cn: exist 讲的是真实存在或活下去。

normal.en: Life may exist under the ice of that moon.
normal.cn: 那颗卫星的冰层下也许存在生命。

normal.en: The old custom still exists in the village.
normal.cn: 这个古老习俗在村里依然存在。

normal.en: Some fish exist in total darkness.
normal.cn: 有些鱼生存在完全黑暗之中。

normal.en: The family existed on very little money.
normal.cn: 这家人靠很少的钱维持生活。

normal.en: Few of these trees exist outside the valley.
normal.cn: 这些树很少生长在山谷之外。

abstract.en: Picture a small light still burning in the dark.
abstract.cn: 想象黑暗中仍有一盏小灯亮着。

abstract.en: Imagine a shape that slowly comes into view.
abstract.cn: 想象一个轮廓慢慢浮现出来。

abstract.en: Think of a candle that refuses to go out.
abstract.cn: 想象一支怎么也不肯熄灭的蜡烛。

examples.en: Scientists wonder whether life exists on that planet.
examples.cn: 科学家想知道那颗行星上是否存在生命。

examples.en: The problem exists mainly in crowded cities.
examples.cn: 这个问题主要存在于拥挤的城市里。

examples.en: They existed for years on a tiny income.
examples.cn: 他们靠微薄的收入生活了很多年。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「exist」读起来像「一个记斯特」，可以联想：只要被记住，就说明它真实「存在」过。

root: 拉丁语 exsistere（出现、存在）由 ex-（向外）与 sistere（站立）构成，核心义「站出来、显现而存在」。

sensesIntro.en: Exist means to be real, to stay alive, or to survive on a small amount.
sensesIntro.cn: exist 意为真实存在、活着，或靠很少的东西维持生存。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something standing there as real.
core.cn: 核心意象：某样东西真实地立在那里。

branches.en: The basic sense is simply being real.
branches.cn: 基本义就是真实存在。

branches.en: Being real narrows to being alive.
branches.cn: 存在收窄为活着。

branches.en: Staying alive depends on a small source.
branches.cn: 活下去要依赖微薄的来源。

branches.en: Both describe something present in the world.
branches.cn: 两者都描述世界上在场的东西。

branches.en: Survival and living on are close in use.
branches.cn: 生存与靠某物活着用法相近。

intro.en: Exist carries the Latin prefix ex- and the verb sistere.
intro.cn: exist 含有拉丁前缀 ex- 与动词 sistere。

latinIntro.en: Latin exsistere joins ex- (out) and sistere (to stand).
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exsistere 由 ex-（向外）与 sistere（站立）组合而成。

items.example: Sistere gives the root of standing.
Exsistere is the direct source of exist.
items.exampleCN: exsistere 是 exist 的直接来源。

items.example: Exist keeps the Latin sense of appearing.
items.exampleCN: exist 保留了拉丁语「显现」之义。

items.example: -Ence turns the verb into a noun.
Existence names the state of being real.

items.exampleCN: existent 描述实际存在的事物。

latinEntries.example: Sistere means to take a stand.
Exsistere is the source of exist.
latinEntries.exampleCN: exsistere 是 exist 的来源。

definition_en: the state of being real or present; a way of living; being itself
core_image: 某样东西被证实真实地在那里
scene: 没有人能证明那种神秘生物的存在。No one can prove the existence of that mysterious creature.
sceneCN: 这里 existence 是「存在」（第 1 个义项）；句意：没有人能证明那种神秘生物的存在。

derivatives.zh: 存在主义的；关于存在的

senses.title: State of being real
senses.definition: the state of being real or present
senses.definitionCN: 真实或有事物存在的状态
senses.example: The existence of dark matter is widely accepted.
senses.exampleCN: 暗物质的存在已被广泛接受。
senses.why: The noun names the fact of being real.
senses.whyCN: 名词形式指「真实存在」这一事实。

senses.title: Way of living
senses.definition: a way of living, often a hard or simple one
senses.definitionCN: 一种生活状态，常指艰苦或简朴的生活
senses.example: The farmer led a simple existence.
senses.exampleCN: 那位农夫过着简朴的生活。
senses.why: Being real becomes the shape of a daily life.
senses.whyCN: 「存在」具体化为日常生活的样子。

senses.title: Being itself
senses.definition: being itself, as studied in philosophy
senses.definitionCN: 哲学所研究的存在本身
senses.example: The book asks what existence really means.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书追问存在究竟意味着什么。
senses.why: The everyday fact is raised to an abstract idea.
senses.whyCN: 日常事实被提升为抽象概念。

intro.en: Existence comes from Latin exsistentia, the noun of exsistere.
intro.cn: existence 源自拉丁语 exsistentia，是 exsistere 的名词形式。

items.en: Exsistere means to come forth and appear.
items.cn: exsistere 意为出现并显现。

items.en: Exsistentia names the resulting state.
items.cn: exsistentia 指由此形成的状态。

items.en: Existence keeps the sense of being present.
items.cn: existence 保留「在场存在」的含义。

items.en: Existence enters as a learned word.
items.cn: existence 作为学术用词进入英语。

items.en: Existence spreads from philosophy to daily use.
items.cn: existence 从哲学扩展到日常用语。

items.en: A simple existence now describes a way of life.
items.cn: a simple existence 如今可描述一种生活方式。

note.en: Existence is about being; insistence is about demanding.
note.cn: existence 关乎存在，insistence 则关乎坚持。

entries.definition: the state of having just enough to live
entries.definitionCN: 维持生存；勉强糊口的生活

normalIntro.en: Existence is the noun for the fact of being.
normalIntro.cn: existence 是表示「存在」这一事实的名词。

normal.en: The existence of the tribe was never doubted.
normal.cn: 这个部落的存在从未被怀疑。

normal.en: He survived on a bare existence in the hills.
normal.cn: 他在山里过着勉强糊口的生活。

normal.en: Philosophers still argue about existence.
normal.cn: 哲学家至今仍在争论存在的问题。

normal.en: The charity brought the school into existence.
normal.cn: 这家慈善机构促成了这所学校的建立。

normal.en: Few species can maintain existence in that heat.
normal.cn: 很少有物种能在那种高温中维持生存。

abstract.en: Picture a footprint that proves someone was there.
abstract.cn: 想象一个脚印证明有人来过。

abstract.en: Imagine a thin thread holding a heavy weight.
abstract.cn: 想象一根细线吊着重物。

abstract.en: Think of a single star in an empty sky.
abstract.cn: 想象空旷夜空中唯一的一颗星。

examples.en: The existence of the document changed the case.
examples.cn: 这份文件的存在改变了案件走向。

examples.en: She described her existence as quiet and simple.
examples.cn: 她把自己的生活形容为安静而简朴。

examples.en: Ancient thinkers asked what existence itself is.
examples.cn: 古代思想家追问存在本身是什么。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「existence」中有 exist（存在），后面接 -ence 变成名词：存在的状态就是「存在」。

root: 拉丁语 exsistere（出现、存在）经名词形式 exsistentia 进入英语，核心义「显现并持续存在」。

sensesIntro.en: Existence means the fact of being real, a way of life, or being itself.
sensesIntro.cn: existence 意为真实存在的事实、一种生活方式，或存在本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: proof that something really is there.
core.cn: 核心意象：某物确实在那里的证据。

branches.en: The main sense is the fact of being real.
branches.cn: 主要义项是真实存在的事实。

branches.en: That fact becomes the shape of a life.
branches.cn: 这一事实成为生活的形态。

branches.en: The fact is raised to a philosophical idea.
branches.cn: 这一事实被提升为哲学概念。

branches.en: Both concern real presence in the world.
branches.cn: 两者都涉及在世界中的真实在场。

branches.en: The concrete fact and the abstract idea pair up.
branches.cn: 具体事实与抽象概念相互对应。

intro.en: Existence builds on exist with the noun suffix -ence.
intro.cn: existence 在 exist 之后加上名词后缀 -ence。

latinIntro.en: Latin exsistere and exsistentia supply the core forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exsistere 与 exsistentia 提供核心词形。

items.example: Sistere gives the idea of standing.
Exsistere is the verb behind existence.
items.exampleCN: exsistere 是 existence 背后的动词。

items.example: Exsistentia is the direct Latin source.
items.exampleCN: exsistentia 是直接的拉丁语来源。

items.example: Existence names the fact of being.
Exist is the verb base of existence.
items.exampleCN: exist 是 existence 的动词词基。

definition_en: a way out of a place; the act of leaving; to go out or leave
core_image: 一扇通向外面、可以走出去的门
scene: 观众从大厅后方的出口有序离场。The audience left through the exit at the back of the hall.
sceneCN: 这里 exit 是「出口」（第 1 个义项）；句意：观众从大厅后方的出口有序离场。

senses.title: Way out
senses.definition: a door or passage that leads out of a place
senses.definitionCN: 通向建筑物外面的门或通道
senses.example: The emergency exit is on your left.
senses.exampleCN: 紧急出口在您的左边。
senses.why: The core object is the opening that lets you out.
senses.whyCN: 核心形象是让人走出去的开口。

senses.title: Act of leaving
senses.definition: the act of leaving a place or situation
senses.definitionCN: 离开某地或某种处境的行为
senses.example: Her exit from the meeting was sudden.
senses.exampleCN: 她突然退出了会议。
senses.why: The opening is now the action of going through it.
senses.whyCN: 出口变成了穿过出口的动作。

senses.title: To leave
senses.definition: to go out of a place or leave a program
senses.definitionCN: 走出某地，或退出某个程序
senses.example: The actors exit from the right side of the stage.
senses.exampleCN: 演员从舞台右侧退场。
senses.why: The noun turns into the verb for going out.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为表示「走出去」的动词。

intro.en: Exit comes from Latin exitus, a going out, from exire.
intro.cn: exit 源自拉丁语 exitus（出去），来自 exire。

items.en: Exitus is the noun for a going out.
items.cn: exitus 是表示「出去」的名词。

items.en: Exire joins ex- (out) with ire (to go).
items.cn: exire 由 ex-（向外）与 ire（走）构成。

items.en: Exitus appears in stage directions.
items.cn: exitus 出现于舞台提示中。

items.en: Issue and exit share the same Latin source.
items.cn: issue 与 exit 同出一源。

items.en: Exit enters English as a stage direction.
items.cn: exit 最初作为舞台提示进入英语。

items.en: Exit now means any way out of a place.
items.cn: 如今 exit 泛指任何出口。

note.en: Exit is a way out; exist means to be real.
note.cn: exit 是出口，exist 则表示存在。

entries.definition: to make someone eager or lively
an opening into a room or building
a way out or a place to release something
the act of leaving a place

normalIntro.en: Exit is the door out and the act of leaving.
normalIntro.cn: exit 既是出去的门，也是离开的动作。

normal.en: The exit sign glowed above the door.
normal.cn: 出口标志在门上方发着光。

normal.en: They made a quick exit when the rain started.
normal.cn: 雨一开始下，他们就迅速离开了。

normal.en: Please exit through the rear door.
normal.cn: 请从后门离开。

normal.en: The stage direction told him to exit left.
normal.cn: 舞台提示让他从左侧退场。

normal.en: The emergency exit was blocked by boxes.
normal.cn: 紧急出口被箱子挡住了。

abstract.en: Picture an open door with light beyond it.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇敞开的门，门后有光。

abstract.en: Imagine stepping out of a crowded room.
abstract.cn: 想象从拥挤的房间里走出去。

abstract.en: Think of a green sign pointing away.
abstract.cn: 想象一块指向远方的绿色指示牌。

examples.en: The nearest exit is beside the stairs.
examples.cn: 最近的出口在楼梯旁边。

examples.en: The singer made a dramatic exit from the stage.
examples.cn: 那位歌手戏剧性地退场了。

examples.en: Passengers exited the train in a hurry.
examples.cn: 乘客们匆匆忙忙地下了火车。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「exit」可拆成 ex（出）+ it（走）：走出去的地方就是「出口」。

root: 拉丁语 exitus（出去）来自 exire（走出），其中 ex- 表示「向外」，ire 表示「走」。

sensesIntro.en: Exit means a way out, the act of leaving, or to leave a place.
sensesIntro.cn: exit 意为出口、离场的行为，或离开某地。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a door that leads outside.
core.cn: 核心意象：一扇通向外面的门。

branches.en: The physical opening is the core sense.
branches.cn: 实体的出口是核心义。

branches.en: Going through it becomes the act of leaving.
branches.cn: 穿过出口成为离开的行为。

branches.en: The act becomes a verb for leaving.
branches.cn: 这一行为转为表示离开的动词。

branches.en: The door and the departure belong together.
branches.cn: 门与离去相互关联。

branches.en: Noun and verb describe the same movement.
branches.cn: 名词与动词描述同一个动作。

intro.en: Exit joins Latin ex- (out) with ire (to go).
intro.cn: exit 由拉丁语 ex-（向外）与 ire（走）组合而成。

latinIntro.en: Latin exire and its noun exitus are the direct sources.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exire 及其名词 exitus 是直接来源。

items.example: Ire supplies the movement in exit.
items.exampleCN: ire 为 exit 提供「走」的含义。

items.example: Exire is the verb behind exit.
items.exampleCN: exire 是 exit 背后的动词。

items.example: Exitus gives the noun its shape.
items.exampleCN: exitus 为这个名词提供词形。
exiting 常见于安全提示中。

latinEntries.example: Ire is a basic verb of motion.
latinEntries.exampleCN: ire 是表示移动的基本动词。

latinEntries.example: Exitus is the noun of departure.
latinEntries.exampleCN: exitus 是表示离开的名词。

definition_en: to become larger in size or amount; to grow in range or business; to give more detail
core_image: 一样东西向四周铺展开、占据更大空间
scene: 加热后金属会明显膨胀，占满缝隙。When heated, the metal will expand and fill the gap.
sceneCN: 这里 expand 是「变大、膨胀」（第 1 个义项）；句意：加热后金属会明显膨胀，占满缝隙。

senses.title: Grow larger
senses.definition: to become larger in size or amount
senses.definitionCN: 在体积或数量上变大
senses.example: Air expands as it warms.
senses.exampleCN: 空气受热会膨胀。
senses.why: The core image is spreading outward.
senses.whyCN: 核心形象是向四周铺展开。

senses.title: Widen range
senses.definition: to grow in range, size, or business
senses.definitionCN: 在范围、规模或业务上扩大
senses.example: The chain expanded to fifty stores.
senses.exampleCN: 这家连锁店扩展到了五十家门店。
senses.why: Physical growth is applied to organizations.
senses.whyCN: 物理上的变大被用于组织扩张。

senses.title: Add detail
senses.definition: to give more detail about something
senses.definitionCN: 对某事给出更多细节
senses.example: She expanded on her earlier comment.
senses.exampleCN: 她进一步说明了先前的评论。
senses.why: Spreading outward becomes spreading out an idea.
senses.whyCN: 向外铺开转化为把观点展开。

intro.en: Expand comes from Latin expandere, to spread out.
intro.cn: expand 源自拉丁语 expandere，意为「铺开」。

items.en: Expandere joins ex- (out) with pandere (to spread).
items.cn: expandere 由 ex-（向外）与 pandere（展开）构成。

items.en: Pandere describes spreading something open.
items.cn: pandere 表示把东西铺展开。

items.en: Expansus is the past participle of expandere.
items.cn: expansus 是 expandere 的过去分词。

items.en: Expanden first means to spread out.
items.cn: expanden 最初意为铺展开。

items.en: Expand grows to mean increase in size.
items.cn: expand 逐渐表示体积增大。

items.en: Expand on adds the sense of explaining more.
items.cn: expand on 增加了「进一步解释」之意。

note.en: Expand means to grow larger; expend means to use up.
note.cn: expand 是扩大，expend 则是花费、耗尽。

entries.definition: to use up money or energy

normalIntro.en: Expand is about spreading out and getting bigger.
normalIntro.cn: expand 讲的是铺展开来、变得更大。

normal.en: The balloon expands as you blow into it.
normal.cn: 你一吹气，气球就膨胀起来。

normal.en: The company expanded into three new markets.
normal.cn: 这家公司扩展到了三个新市场。

normal.en: The teacher asked him to expand on his answer.
normal.cn: 老师让他进一步展开回答。

normal.en: Warm air expands and rises.
normal.cn: 暖空气膨胀上升。

normal.en: The library plans to expand its reading room.
normal.cn: 图书馆计划扩建阅览室。

abstract.en: Picture a small circle growing wider.
abstract.cn: 想象一个小圆圈越来越宽。

abstract.en: Imagine a map unfolding across a table.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图在桌上铺展开。

abstract.en: Think of a sponge swelling in water.
abstract.cn: 想象一块海绵在水里胀大。

examples.en: The metal expands when the temperature rises.
examples.cn: 温度升高时金属会膨胀。

examples.en: They hope to expand the program next year.
examples.cn: 他们希望明年扩大这个项目。

examples.en: The bridge design was expanded during the war.
examples.cn: 这座桥的设计在战争期间被扩充了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「expand」里有 ex（向外）+ pand（展开）：向外展开，就是「扩大」。

root: 拉丁语 expandere 由 ex-（向外）与 pandere（展开）构成，核心义「向外铺开」。

sensesIntro.en: Expand means to grow larger, widen a range, or explain in more detail.
sensesIntro.cn: expand 意为变大、扩大范围，或更详细地说明。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something spreading outward.
core.cn: 核心意象：某物向四周铺展开。

branches.en: Physical spreading is the core sense.
branches.cn: 物理上的铺开是核心义。

branches.en: Growth applies to companies and areas.
branches.cn: 「变大」被用于公司和地区。

branches.en: An idea is spread out with more words.
branches.cn: 观点用更多文字展开。

branches.en: Both involve increase in size or scope.
branches.cn: 两者都涉及体积或范围的增长。

branches.en: Widening scope and adding detail both extend.
branches.cn: 扩大范围与补充细节都是一种延伸。

intro.en: Expand carries the Latin prefix ex- and the verb pandere.
intro.cn: expand 含有拉丁前缀 ex- 与动词 pandere。

latinIntro.en: Latin expandere joins ex- (out) and pandere (to spread).
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 expandere 由 ex-（向外）与 pandere（展开）组合。

items.example: Pandere gives the idea of spreading.
Expandere is the direct source of expand.
items.exampleCN: expandere 是 expand 的直接来源。

items.example: Expand keeps the sense of spreading.
Expansion names the process of growing.

latinEntries.exampleCN: pandere 是表示展开的动词。

definition_en: the process of becoming larger; growth in business or territory; a fuller development of an idea
core_image: 版图或体积不断向外扩大的过程
scene: 这家企业的快速扩张带来了数千个岗位。The rapid expansion of the firm created thousands of jobs.
sceneCN: 这里 expansion 是「扩张、扩展」（第 2 个义项）；句意：这家企业的快速扩张带来了数千个岗位。

senses.title: Growth in size
senses.definition: the process of becoming larger in size or volume
senses.definitionCN: 体积或容量变大的过程
senses.example: Thermal expansion can crack the glass.
senses.exampleCN: 热膨胀可能使玻璃开裂。
senses.why: The noun names the process behind expand.
senses.whyCN: 名词形式指 expand 背后的过程。

senses.title: Business growth
senses.definition: growth in business, territory, or influence
senses.definitionCN: 业务、领土或影响力上的增长
senses.example: The expansion of the network took five years.
senses.exampleCN: 网络的扩张花了五年时间。
senses.why: Physical growth is applied to organizations and land.
senses.whyCN: 物理上的扩大被用于组织和土地。

senses.title: Added detail
senses.definition: a fuller development of an idea in speech or writing
senses.definitionCN: 在口头或书面中把观点充分展开
senses.example: The essay needs an expansion of its main argument.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇文章需要把主要论点展开。
senses.why: Spreading outward becomes spreading out an argument.
senses.whyCN: 向外铺开转化为把论点展开。

intro.en: Expansion comes from Latin expansio, a spreading out.
intro.cn: expansion 源自拉丁语 expansio，意为「铺展开」。

items.en: Expansio is the noun for a spreading out.
items.cn: expansio 是表示铺开的名词。

items.en: It comes from expandere, to spread open.
items.cn: 它来自 expandere，意为铺展开。

items.en: Expansus supplies the participle stem.
items.cn: expansus 提供分词词干。

items.en: Expansioun names the act of spreading.
items.cn: expansioun 指铺开的动作。

items.en: Expansion covers growth of land and trade.
items.cn: expansion 涵盖土地与贸易的增长。

items.en: Expansion also names added detail in writing.
items.cn: expansion 还指写作中的展开补充。

note.en: Expansion is growth; expense is money spent.
note.cn: expansion 是扩张，expense 则是开支。

entries.definition: a wide area of land or space
the size or range of something
the act of making something longer or wider
the act of making something bigger

normalIntro.en: Expansion is the noun for growing or spreading.
normalIntro.cn: expansion 是表示扩大或铺开的名词。

normal.en: The expansion of the airport began last spring.
normal.cn: 机场的扩建去年春天开工。

normal.en: Thermal expansion explains the loose lid.
normal.cn: 热膨胀可以解释盖子为何变松。

normal.en: The company funded its expansion with a loan.
normal.cn: 公司靠贷款为扩张提供资金。

normal.en: His expansion of the theory filled three pages.
normal.cn: 他对该理论的展开写了三页。

normal.en: Economic expansion brought new jobs to the town.
normal.cn: 经济扩张给小镇带来了新工作。

abstract.en: Picture a map quietly growing at its edges.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图的边缘悄悄向外延伸。

abstract.en: Imagine a circle widening on still water.
abstract.cn: 想象静水面上一个圆圈不断扩大。

abstract.en: Think of a story that keeps adding chapters.
abstract.cn: 想象一个不断添加章节的故事。

examples.en: The expansion of the railway changed the region.
examples.cn: 铁路的扩张改变了这个地区。

examples.en: Heat causes the expansion of the metal bar.
examples.cn: 热量使金属棒膨胀。

examples.en: The report offers a detailed expansion of the plan.
examples.cn: 这份报告对计划作了详细展开。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「expansion」是 expand（扩大）的名词形式，-sion 表示动作或结果。

root: 拉丁语 expansio（展开）来自 expandere，表示「向外铺开」的动作与结果。

sensesIntro.en: Expansion means growth in size, growth in business or land, or a fuller development of an idea.
sensesIntro.cn: expansion 意为体积增大、业务或领土扩张，或观点的展开。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an area or volume pushing outward.
core.cn: 核心意象：面积或体积不断向外扩。

branches.en: The process of growing larger is the base.
branches.cn: 变大的过程是基础义。

branches.en: Growing is applied to business and land.
branches.cn: 「变大」被用于业务与土地。

branches.en: An argument is spread out in more detail.
branches.cn: 论点被更详细地展开。

branches.en: Both are forms of increase and extension.
branches.cn: 两者都是增长与延伸。

branches.en: Wider scope and added detail both expand ideas.
branches.cn: 扩大范围与补充细节都在扩展观点。

intro.en: Expansion builds on Latin expandere with the suffix -sion.
intro.cn: expansion 在拉丁语 expandere 基础上加后缀 -sion。

latinIntro.en: Latin expansio and expandere supply the core forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 expansio 与 expandere 提供核心词形。

items.example: Expand is the verb behind the noun.
items.exampleCN: expand 是名词背后的动词。

definition_en: to think that something will happen; to believe someone should do something; to be waiting for a person or event
core_image: 朝着前方张望，心里等着某件事发生
scene: 我们预计火车会晚点到达。We expect the train to arrive late.
sceneCN: 这里 expect 是「预料、预期」（第 1 个义项）；句意：我们预计火车会晚点到达。

senses.title: Think it will happen
senses.definition: to think that something will happen
senses.definitionCN: 认为某事将会发生
senses.example: We expect rain before evening.
senses.exampleCN: 我们预计傍晚前会下雨。
senses.why: The core sense is looking forward in the mind.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是在心里向前张望。

senses.title: Believe someone should
senses.definition: to believe that someone should do something
senses.definitionCN: 认为某人应该做某事
senses.example: The teacher expects us to be on time.
senses.exampleCN: 老师期望我们准时。
senses.why: A prediction becomes a standard for others.
senses.whyCN: 预测变成了对他人的要求标准。

senses.title: Wait for
senses.definition: to be waiting for a person or event
senses.definitionCN: 等着某个人或某件事到来
senses.example: She is expecting a call from her brother.
senses.exampleCN: 她正等着哥哥的电话。
senses.why: Looking forward becomes active waiting.
senses.whyCN: 向前张望变成了主动等待。

intro.en: Expect comes from Latin exspectare, to look out for.
intro.cn: expect 源自拉丁语 exspectare，意为「向外张望、等候」。

items.en: Exspectare joins ex- (out) with spectare (to look).
items.cn: exspectare 由 ex-（向外）与 spectare（看）构成。

items.en: Spectare means to watch or look at.
items.cn: spectare 意为观看、注视。

items.en: Exspectare means to look out for something.
items.cn: exspectare 意为留意等候某事。

items.en: Expecten carries the sense of waiting.
items.cn: expecten 带有等候的含义。

items.en: Expect adds the belief that something will happen.
items.cn: expect 增加了「认为某事会发生」的含义。

items.en: Expect to is a very common pattern.
items.cn: expect to 成为非常常见的搭配。

note.en: Expect is about the future; inspect is about looking closely.
note.cn: expect 面向未来，inspect 则是仔细查看。

entries.definition: to think someone may be guilty
to expect and prepare for something
to think something is probably true

normalIntro.en: Expect is looking ahead and thinking something will come.
normalIntro.cn: expect 是向前看，认定某事会到来。

normal.en: We expect the results on Friday.
normal.cn: 我们预计周五出结果。

normal.en: She expects her students to read daily.
normal.cn: 她期望学生每天阅读。

normal.en: The storm came earlier than expected.
normal.cn: 暴风雨比预料的来得早。

normal.en: He is expecting a parcel from abroad.
normal.cn: 他正等着一个海外包裹。

normal.en: Do not expect too much from one lesson.
normal.cn: 不要指望一节课能学到太多。

abstract.en: Picture someone watching the road for a bus.
abstract.cn: 想象有人望着马路等公交。

abstract.en: Imagine a clock ticking toward a known hour.
abstract.cn: 想象时钟走向一个已知的时刻。

abstract.en: Think of a door you are sure will open.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇你确信会打开的门。

examples.en: Economists expect prices to rise slowly.
examples.cn: 经济学家预计物价会缓慢上涨。

examples.en: Parents expect children to tell the truth.
examples.cn: 父母期望孩子说真话。

examples.en: The team was expected to win the final.
examples.cn: 这支队伍被认为会赢得决赛。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「expect」可拆成 ex（向外）+ spect（看）：向外张望，就是在「期待、预料」。

root: 拉丁语 exspectare 由 ex-（向外）与 spectare（看）构成，核心义「向外张望、等候」。

sensesIntro.en: Expect means to think something will happen, to require it of someone, or to wait for it.
sensesIntro.cn: expect 意为预料某事会发生、要求某人做到，或等待某事。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: looking ahead toward a coming event.
core.cn: 核心意象：朝前方张望即将发生的事。

branches.en: The base sense is foreseeing an event.
branches.cn: 基础义是预见某事。

branches.en: Foreseeing becomes a demand on others.
branches.cn: 预见变成对他人的要求。

branches.en: Foreseeing becomes active waiting.
branches.cn: 预见变成主动的等待。

branches.en: Belief and requirement often appear together.
branches.cn: 相信与要求常常同时出现。

branches.en: Prediction and waiting share the forward look.
branches.cn: 预测与等待共享向前张望的姿态。

intro.en: Expect joins Latin ex- (out) with spectare (to look).
intro.cn: expect 由拉丁语 ex-（向外）与 spectare（看）组合。

latinIntro.en: Latin exspectare and spectare supply the core forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exspectare 与 spectare 提供核心词形。

items.example: Spectare gives the idea of watching.
Exspectare is the direct source of expect.
items.exampleCN: exspectare 是 expect 的直接来源。

items.example: Expect keeps the sense of looking ahead.
items.exampleCN: expect 保留向前看的含义。

items.example: Expectation names what is looked for.

items.exampleCN: expected 描述已被预见的事物。

definition_en: a belief that something will happen; a hope or requirement; the standards people expect you to meet
core_image: 心里悬着一个「应该会发生」的念头
scene: 她的表现远远超出了大家的预期。Her performance went far beyond everyone's expectation.
sceneCN: 这里 expectation 是「预期、期望」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她的表现远远超出了大家的预期。

senses.title: Belief about the future
senses.definition: a belief that something will happen
senses.definitionCN: 相信某事将会发生的看法
senses.example: The result was beyond our expectation.
senses.exampleCN: 结果超出了我们的预期。
senses.why: The noun names the belief itself.
senses.whyCN: 名词形式指这种信念本身。

senses.title: Hope or requirement
senses.definition: a strong hope that something will happen
senses.definitionCN: 强烈希望某事发生
senses.example: She has high expectations for her students.
senses.exampleCN: 她对学生们抱有很高的期望。
senses.why: Belief becomes a wish or a demand.
senses.whyCN: 信念变成愿望或要求。

senses.title: Standards to meet
senses.definition: the standards that people expect you to meet
senses.definitionCN: 人们期待你达到的标准
senses.example: He struggled to meet the expectations of the job.
senses.exampleCN: 他努力想达到这份工作的要求。
senses.why: A hope hardens into a social standard.
senses.whyCN: 希望固化为社会标准。

intro.en: Expectation comes from Latin exspectatio, a looking out for.
intro.cn: expectation 源自拉丁语 exspectatio，意为「向外张望、等候」。

items.en: Exspectatio is the noun of exspectare.
items.cn: exspectatio 是 exspectare 的名词形式。

items.en: Exspectare means to look out for something.
items.cn: exspectare 意为留意等候某事。

items.en: Expectacion keeps the sense of waiting.
items.cn: expectacion 保留等候的含义。

items.en: Expectacioun names a looking forward.
items.cn: expectacioun 指向前张望。

items.en: Expectation adds the sense of a demand.
items.cn: expectation 增加了「要求」之义。

items.en: Expectations often means standards to meet.
items.cn: expectations 常指需要达到的标准。

note.en: Expectation is what you believe will happen; an exception is something left out.
note.cn: expectation 是你相信会发生的事，exception 则是例外。

entries.definition: a case not included in a rule
a view of what may happen

normalIntro.en: Expectation is the noun for what you think will happen.
normalIntro.cn: expectation 是表示「你认为会发生什么」的名词。

normal.en: The film exceeded all our expectations.
normal.cn: 这部电影超出了我们所有的预期。

normal.en: Parents often place high expectations on children.
normal.cn: 父母常对孩子寄予厚望。

normal.en: Against all expectations, the team won.
normal.cn: 出乎所有人意料，这支队伍赢了。

normal.en: The new restaurant did not meet expectations.
normal.cn: 这家新餐厅没有达到预期。

normal.en: Her expectation of a quiet evening was ruined.
normal.cn: 她想要安静夜晚的期望落空了。

abstract.en: Picture a closed box you believe is full.
abstract.cn: 想象一个你相信装满东西的盒子。

abstract.en: Imagine a path that leads to a guessed door.
abstract.cn: 想象一条通往猜测之门的道路。

abstract.en: Think of a score card waiting to be filled.
abstract.cn: 想象一张等着填分的记分卡。

examples.en: The quality of the meal went beyond expectation.
examples.cn: 这顿饭的品质超出了预期。

examples.en: She had little expectation of winning the prize.
examples.cn: 她几乎没指望能得奖。

examples.en: The job failed to meet his expectations.
examples.cn: 这份工作没能达到他的期望。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「expectation」由 expect（期待）加 -ation 构成：期待这件事本身，就是「预期」。

root: 拉丁语 exspectare（向外张望、等候）的名词形式 exspectatio 进入英语，核心义「所期待之事」。

sensesIntro.en: Expectation means a belief about the future, a hope, or the standards others set for you.
sensesIntro.cn: expectation 意为对未来的预期、一种希望，或他人为你设定的标准。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thought fixed on a coming result.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个念头锁定在即将到来的结果上。

branches.en: The base sense is a belief about the future.
branches.cn: 基础义是对未来的信念。

branches.en: The belief becomes a strong hope.
branches.cn: 信念变成强烈的希望。

branches.en: The hope becomes a standard to meet.
branches.cn: 希望变成需达到的标准。

branches.en: Prediction and hope share one forward look.
branches.cn: 预测与希望共享同一种向前看。

branches.en: Personal hope and social standard are linked.
branches.cn: 个人希望与社会标准相互关联。

intro.en: Expectation adds the noun suffix -ation to expect.
intro.cn: expectation 在 expect 后加名词后缀 -ation。

latinIntro.en: Latin exspectare and exspectatio are the source forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exspectare 与 exspectatio 是来源词形。

items.exampleCN: expectant 加上了形容词词尾。

definition_en: the amount of money spent; the act of spending money; the use of time or energy
core_image: 一笔钱被称量后付出去
scene: 政府计划削减明年的公共开支。The government plans to cut public expenditure next year.
sceneCN: 这里 expenditure 是「支出、经费」（第 1 个义项）；句意：政府计划削减明年的公共开支。

senses.title: Money spent
senses.definition: the amount of money that is spent
senses.definitionCN: 花出去的钱的总额
senses.example: Public expenditure rose sharply last year.
senses.exampleCN: 去年公共开支大幅上升。
senses.why: The noun names money paid out.
senses.whyCN: 名词形式指付出去的钱。

senses.title: Budget item
senses.definition: a particular sum of money used for a purpose
senses.definitionCN: 为某一用途拨出的一笔钱
senses.example: The school increased its expenditure on books.
senses.exampleCN: 学校增加了购书经费。
senses.why: Money paid out is organized into budget items.
senses.whyCN: 支出的钱被归入预算项目。

senses.title: Use of energy
senses.definition: the use of time, energy, or effort
senses.definitionCN: 时间、精力或努力的使用
senses.example: The project required a huge expenditure of energy.
senses.exampleCN: 这个项目需要消耗巨大的精力。
senses.why: Spending extends from money to effort.
senses.whyCN: 「花费」从金钱扩展到精力。

intro.en: Expenditure comes from Latin expendere, to weigh out and pay.
intro.cn: expenditure 源自拉丁语 expendere，意为「称量后付出」。

items.en: Expendere means to weigh out and pay.
items.cn: expendere 意为称量后支付。

items.en: It joins ex- (out) with pendere (to weigh).
items.cn: 它由 ex-（向外）与 pendere（称量）构成。

items.en: Expenditura names money paid out.
items.cn: expenditura 指付出去的钱。

items.en: Expenditure is used in accounts.
items.cn: expenditure 出现在账目用语中。

items.en: Expenditure covers money and energy used.
items.cn: expenditure 涵盖花掉的钱与消耗的精力。

items.en: Public expenditure is a common phrase.
items.cn: public expenditure 成为常用搭配。

note.en: Expenditure is money paid out; an expedition is a journey.
note.cn: expenditure 是支出，expedition 则是远征。

entries.definition: able to be used up or sacrificed

normalIntro.en: Expenditure is the money or energy you pay out.
normalIntro.cn: expenditure 就是你付出去的钱或精力。

normal.en: The city reduced expenditure on new roads.
normal.cn: 市里削减了新修道路的开支。

normal.en: Capital expenditure rose with the new factory.
normal.cn: 随着新工厂建设，资本支出上升。

normal.en: They kept a record of every expenditure.
normal.cn: 他们记录每一笔支出。

normal.en: The rescue needed a great expenditure of effort.
normal.cn: 那次救援耗费了巨大的努力。

normal.en: Health expenditure takes a large share of the budget.
normal.cn: 医疗开支占预算的很大一部分。

abstract.en: Picture coins weighed on a small scale.
abstract.cn: 想象硬币在小秤上被称量。

abstract.en: Imagine a ledger with columns of payments.
abstract.cn: 想象一本记满付款栏目的账簿。

abstract.en: Think of energy pouring out like water.
abstract.cn: 想象精力像水一样流出去。

examples.en: The report tracks government expenditure each year.
examples.cn: 这份报告追踪每年的政府开支。

examples.en: They argued about the expenditure on the new bridge.
examples.cn: 他们为修建新桥的开支争论不休。

examples.en: The task demanded a large expenditure of time.
examples.cn: 这项任务需要投入大量时间。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「expenditure」里有 expend（花费）：把钱包里的钱向外称出去，就是「支出」。

root: 拉丁语 expendere（称量后支付）由 ex-（向外）与 pendere（称量）构成，核心义「把钱称出去」。

sensesIntro.en: Expenditure means money spent, a budget item, or the use of time and energy.
sensesIntro.cn: expenditure 意为花掉的钱、一笔经费，或时间与精力的消耗。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: money weighed and paid out.
core.cn: 核心意象：把钱包称量后付出去。

branches.en: The base sense is money paid out.
branches.cn: 基础义是付出的钱。

branches.en: Payments are grouped into budget lines.
branches.cn: 付款被归入预算项目。

branches.en: Paying out extends to effort and time.
branches.cn: 「付出」扩展到精力与时间。

branches.en: Total spending and single items pair together.
branches.cn: 总支出与单项经费相互对应。

branches.en: Money and energy are both resources spent.
branches.cn: 金钱与精力都是被消耗的资源。

intro.en: Expenditure builds on expend with the suffix -ure.
intro.cn: expenditure 在 expend 后加后缀 -ure。

latinIntro.en: Latin expendere and expenditura supply the core forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 expendere 与 expenditura 提供核心词形。

items.example: Pendere gives the image of weighing money.
items.exampleCN: pendere 提供称量钱币的形象。

items.example: Expendere is the source of expend.
items.exampleCN: expendere 是 expend 的来源。

items.example: Expendable describes what can be lost.
items.exampleCN: expendable 描述可以消耗掉的东西。

definition_en: the money needed or spent for something; something that costs money; the loss or sacrifice involved
core_image: 为得到某样东西而付出的钱
scene: 他把差旅费用记在了公司账上。He put the travel expenses on the company account.
sceneCN: 这里 expense 是「费用、开支」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他把差旅费用记在了公司账上。

senses.title: Cost of something
senses.definition: the money needed or spent for something
senses.definitionCN: 为某事物所需或所花的钱
senses.example: The expense of the trip was too high.
senses.exampleCN: 这趟旅行的费用太高了。
senses.why: The base sense is money laid out.
senses.whyCN: 基础义是付出去的钱。

senses.title: Money for work
senses.definition: money spent for a particular purpose, often repaid by an employer
senses.definitionCN: 为特定用途支出、常由雇主报销的钱
senses.example: She kept every receipt to claim her expenses.
senses.exampleCN: 她保留每张收据以便报销。
senses.why: The cost is tied to a job or purpose.

senses.title: Price paid

senses.why: Money cost becomes any kind of cost.
senses.whyCN: 金钱成本扩展为任何代价。

items.en: Expensa is money paid out.

items.en: Expense enters as a business term.

items.en: Expense covers both cost and sacrifice.
items.cn: expense 同时涵盖费用与牺牲。

items.en: At the expense of is a fixed phrase.

normalIntro.cn: expense 是你付出的钱或其他代价。

normal.en: The trip was worth the expense.

normal.cn: 他们为婚礼不惜花费。

examples.en: They built the tower at the expense of the old park.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: money laid down for something wanted.

definition_zh: 昂贵的；代价高的；奢华的
definition_en: costing a lot of money; causing a serious loss; belonging to a high-priced and luxurious class
core_image: 价签上的数字大得让人犹豫

senses.title: Costing a lot
senses.definition: costing a lot of money
senses.definitionCN: 需要花很多钱的

senses.why: The core sense is a high price.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是高昂的价格。

senses.title: Costly in loss
senses.definition: causing a serious loss of money or other things
senses.definitionCN: 造成金钱或其他方面严重损失的
senses.example: The delay proved an expensive mistake.
senses.exampleCN: 这次延误被证明是个代价高昂的错误。
senses.why: High money cost extends to any heavy loss.
senses.whyCN: 高额金钱成本扩展到任何重大损失。

senses.title: High-class and costly
senses.definition: belonging to a high-priced and luxurious class
senses.definitionCN: 属于价格高昂、奢华一类的
senses.example: They stayed in an expensive hotel by the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 他们住在海边一家奢华的酒店。
senses.why: Price becomes a mark of luxury and status.
senses.whyCN: 价格成为奢华与身份的标记。

normal.en: Fixing that mistake was an expensive lesson.

normal.en: She has expensive tastes in furniture.

normal.cn: 旧船维护起来费用很高。

normal.en: The most expensive seats sold out first.

abstract.en: Picture a price tag larger than the product.
abstract.cn: 想象价签比商品还大。

abstract.en: Imagine a velvet rope guarding a luxury shop.
abstract.cn: 想象一条丝绒围栏护着奢侈品店。

abstract.en: Think of a wallet growing lighter at the counter.
abstract.cn: 想象在柜台前钱包越来越轻。

examples.cn: 首都的住房已经变得非常昂贵。

examples.cn: 他们选择更便宜的路线以免旅途花费过高。

intro.en: Expensive is expense plus the adjective suffix -ive.

definition_en: knowledge or skill gained by doing something; an event that you go through; to feel or undergo something
core_image: 亲自走过一段路后留在心里的东西
scene: 她在这个行业有十年的工作经验。She has ten years of experience in the industry.
sceneCN: 这里 experience 是「经验」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她在这个行业有十年的工作经验。

senses.title: Knowledge from doing
senses.definition: knowledge or skill gained by doing something
senses.definitionCN: 通过做事获得的知识或技能
senses.example: She has years of experience in teaching.
senses.exampleCN: 她有多年教学经验。
senses.why: The core sense is knowledge earned by practice.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是通过实践获得的知识。

senses.title: Event you live through
senses.definition: an event that you go through
senses.definitionCN: 你亲身经历的一件事情
senses.example: The trip was a strange experience.
senses.exampleCN: 这趟旅行是一次奇怪的经历。
senses.why: The knowledge comes from a particular event.
senses.whyCN: 知识来自某一次具体经历。

senses.title: To undergo
senses.definition: to feel or undergo something
senses.definitionCN: 感受或经历某事
senses.example: Many patients experience severe pain.
senses.exampleCN: 许多病人感到剧烈疼痛。
senses.why: The noun turns into the act of living through.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为亲身经历的动作。

intro.en: Experience comes from Latin experientia, knowledge from trials.
intro.cn: experience 源自拉丁语 experientia，意为「通过尝试得到的知识」。

items.en: Experiri means to try or test.
items.cn: experiri 意为尝试、试验。

items.en: Experientia names the knowledge gained.
items.cn: experientia 指由此获得的知识。

items.en: Experience keeps the sense of trial.
items.cn: experience 保留「尝试」的含义。

items.en: Experience covers both skill and event.
items.cn: experience 同时涵盖技能与事件。

items.en: The verb experience means to undergo.
items.cn: 动词 experience 表示亲身经历。

items.en: Work experience becomes a common phrase.
items.cn: work experience 成为常见说法。

note.en: Experience is gained by living; an experiment is a planned test.
note.cn: experience 靠亲身经历获得，experiment 则是计划好的试验。

entries.definition: what is convenient rather than right

normalIntro.en: Experience is what you gain by going through things.
normalIntro.cn: experience 是你亲身经历后留下的收获。

normal.en: The job gave him useful experience.
normal.cn: 这份工作给了他有用的经验。

normal.en: Living abroad was a rich experience.
normal.cn: 在国外生活是一段丰富的经历。

normal.en: She experienced a sudden loss of hearing.
normal.cn: 她经历了突然的听力丧失。

normal.en: He learned patience from experience.
normal.cn: 他从经验中学会了耐心。

normal.en: The team has little experience of cold weather.
normal.cn: 这支队对寒冷天气缺乏经验。

abstract.en: Picture footprints left on a long path.
abstract.cn: 想象长路上留下的脚印。

abstract.en: Imagine a notebook slowly filled with lessons.
abstract.cn: 想象一本笔记慢慢记满教训。

abstract.en: Think of a scar that carries a story.
abstract.cn: 想象一道带着故事的疤痕。

examples.en: The manager values experience more than degrees.
examples.cn: 这位经理看重经验胜过学历。

examples.en: Moving to a new city was a difficult experience.
examples.cn: 搬到一座新城市是一段艰难的经历。

examples.en: Some children experience fear on the first day.
examples.cn: 有些孩子第一天会感到害怕。

root: 拉丁语 experiri（尝试、试验）的名词 experientia 进入英语，核心义「亲身试过之后得到的知识」。

sensesIntro.en: Experience means skill from practice, an event you live through, or to undergo something.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a trace left by walking a road yourself.

branches.en: The noun becomes the act of undergoing.

definition_en: a scientific test to learn something; a trial of a new idea; to try something new
core_image: 在受控条件下反复试一件事，看结果如何
scene: 学生们在实验室里重复了这个实验。The students repeated the experiment in the lab.
sceneCN: 这里 experiment 是「实验」（第 1 个义项）；句意：学生们在实验室里重复了这个实验。

senses.title: Scientific test
senses.definition: a scientific test done to learn something
senses.definitionCN: 为了解某事而进行的科学测试
senses.example: The experiment proved the theory wrong.
senses.exampleCN: 这个实验证明该理论是错的。
senses.why: The core sense is a controlled test.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是受控的测试。

senses.title: Trial of an idea
senses.definition: a trial of a new idea or method
senses.definitionCN: 对新想法或新方法的试行
senses.example: The school ran an experiment in outdoor lessons.
senses.exampleCN: 学校试行了一种户外课堂。
senses.why: Science extends to social and personal trials.
senses.whyCN: 科学实验扩展到社会与个人层面的尝试。

senses.title: To try new things
senses.definition: to try something new or different
senses.definitionCN: 尝试新事物或不同的做法
senses.example: He experimented with different colors.
senses.exampleCN: 他尝试了不同的颜色。
senses.why: The noun becomes the act of trying.
senses.whyCN: 名词转化为尝试的动作。

intro.cn: experiment 源自拉丁语 experimentum，意为「试验、证明」。

items.en: Experimentum names a trial or proof.
items.cn: experimentum 指试验或证明。

items.en: It comes from experiri, to try.
items.cn: 它来自 experiri，意为尝试。

items.en: Experiment keeps the sense of testing.
items.cn: experiment 保留测试的含义。

items.en: Experiment enters the language of science.

items.en: Experiment adds the sense of a new trial.

normal.en: The class did a simple experiment with water.
normal.cn: 全班用水做了一个简单实验。

normal.en: The company ran an experiment in shorter hours.
normal.cn: 公司试行了缩短工时的做法。

normal.en: She experimented with a new recipe.
normal.cn: 她尝试了一种新食谱。

normal.en: The experiment failed and they tried again.
normal.cn: 实验失败后他们又试了一次。

normal.en: A good experiment needs a clear control.

abstract.cn: 想象并排放着的两根玻璃管。

abstract.cn: 想象只改变一件事并观察其余变化。

abstract.en: Think of a notebook full of trial results.

examples.en: The experiment showed that plants need light.

examples.en: They experimented with solar power on the roof.

examples.en: The new teaching method is still an experiment.

latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 experimentum 与 experiri 提供核心词形。

items.en: Experimentum means a trial or proof.
items.cn: experimentum 意为试验或证明。

items.en: It comes from experiri, to try.

items.en: Experiment enters English as a learned word.

items.en: Experimental is used in science writing.

normalIntro.cn: experimental 意为仍在试验中，或建立在实验之上。

normal.cn: 团队收集了好几个月的实验数据。

normal.en: The treatment remains experimental for now.
normal.cn: 这种疗法目前仍是试验性的。

normal.en: They staged an experimental play in the park.
normal.cn: 他们在公园上演了一部实验戏剧。

normal.en: Experimental evidence supported the claim.
normal.cn: 实验证据支持了这一说法。

normal.en: The plane flew on an experimental engine.

examples.en: The experimental results were hard to repeat.
examples.cn: 这些实验结果很难重复。

examples.en: The doctor warned that the method was experimental.
examples.cn: 医生提醒这种方法仍是试验性的。

examples.en: They moved into an experimental style of design.
examples.cn: 他们转向了一种实验性的设计风格。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「experimental」是 experiment（实验）加 -al：与实验有关的，就是「实验的、试验性的」。

root: 由 experiment（实验）加形容词后缀 -al 构成，而 experiment 源自拉丁语 experimentum（试验、证明）。

sensesIntro.en: Experimental means related to experiments, not yet proven, or boldly unusual in method.
sensesIntro.cn: experimental 意为与实验有关的、尚未证实的，或方法上大胆创新的。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something still under test.
core.cn: 核心意象：仍处在测试中的事物。

branches.en: The base sense links the word to tests.
branches.cn: 基础义把词与实验联系起来。

branches.en: Testing leaves the result unproven.
branches.cn: 测试意味着结果尚未证实。

branches.en: Testing becomes a bold new style.
branches.cn: 试验变成大胆的新风格。

branches.en: Test work and uncertain results go together.
branches.cn: 实验工作与不确定的结果相伴。

branches.en: Unproven methods and new art share boldness.
branches.cn: 未证实的方法与新艺术共享大胆。

intro.en: Experimental is experiment plus the adjective suffix -al.

latinIntro.en: Latin experimentum supplies the base of the word.

definition_en: a person with special knowledge or skill; someone very good at something; skilled and authoritative
core_image: 反复试过很多次、终于练得极熟的人
scene: 她请了一位专家来评估这幅画。She asked an expert to value the painting.
sceneCN: 这里 expert 是「专家」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她请了一位专家来评估这幅画。

senses.title: Person with knowledge
senses.definition: a person with special knowledge of a subject
senses.definitionCN: 对某一领域有专门知识的人
senses.example: She is an expert in marine biology.
senses.exampleCN: 她是海洋生物学专家。
senses.why: The core sense is special knowledge.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是专门知识。

senses.title: Skilled person
senses.definition: someone very good at doing something
senses.definitionCN: 非常擅长做某事的人
senses.example: He is an expert at fixing engines.
senses.exampleCN: 他是修理发动机的能手。
senses.why: Knowledge is shown through practical skill.
senses.whyCN: 知识通过实际技能体现出来。

senses.title: Skilled
senses.definition: done with special skill or authority
senses.definitionCN: 以专门技能或权威完成的
senses.example: We need expert advice before we decide.
senses.exampleCN: 决定之前我们需要专业建议。
senses.why: The person's quality becomes an adjective.
senses.whyCN: 人的特质转化为形容词。

intro.en: Expert comes from Latin expertus, tried and experienced.
intro.cn: expert 源自拉丁语 expertus，意为「经过尝试、有经验的」。

items.en: Expertus is the past participle of experiri.
items.cn: expertus 是 experiri 的过去分词。

items.en: Experiri means to try and test.
items.cn: experiri 意为尝试与检验。

items.en: Expert keeps the sense of being tried.
items.cn: expert 保留「经过检验」的含义。

items.en: Expert first describes a skilled person.
items.cn: expert 最初形容有技能的人。

items.en: Expert becomes a noun for a specialist.
items.cn: expert 成为表示专家的名词。

items.en: Expert advice is a common phrase.
items.cn: expert advice 成为常用搭配。

note.en: An expert has special skill; an export is a good sent abroad.
note.cn: expert 是有专门技能的人，export 则是出口商品。

entries.definition: a good sold to another country
a short part taken from a text

normalIntro.en: An expert has tried a field again and again.
normalIntro.cn: expert 是在某一领域反复试练过的人。

normal.en: The museum called in an expert on old coins.
normal.cn: 博物馆请来了一位古钱币专家。

normal.en: She is an expert at calming frightened animals.
normal.cn: 她擅长安抚受惊的动物。

normal.en: They sought expert advice before building.
normal.cn: 动工前他们寻求了专业建议。

normal.en: The expert explained the painting's history.
normal.cn: 专家讲解了这幅画的历史。

normal.en: Even experts disagree about the cause.
normal.cn: 就连专家们对原因也有分歧。

abstract.en: Picture hands that have practiced for years.
abstract.cn: 想象一双练习多年的手。

abstract.en: Imagine a shelf of well-worn reference books.
abstract.cn: 想象一排翻旧了的参考书。

abstract.en: Think of a steady eye judging fine detail.
abstract.cn: 想象一双稳稳审视细节的眼睛。

examples.en: An expert checked the bridge for cracks.
examples.cn: 一位专家检查了桥梁是否有裂缝。

examples.en: She became an expert at reading old maps.
examples.cn: 她成了阅读古地图的能手。

examples.en: The report was written with expert care.
examples.cn: 这份报告以专业水准写成。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「expert」与 experience（经验）同源：经验多到极致的人，就是「专家」。

root: 拉丁语 expertus（经过尝试的）来自 experiri（尝试），核心义「反复试过、因而精通的人」。

sensesIntro.en: Expert means a specialist, a skilled person, or something done with professional skill.
sensesIntro.cn: expert 意为专家、能手，或以专业技能完成的。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person refined by repeated practice.
core.cn: 核心意象：经反复练习而精熟的人。

branches.en: The base sense is special knowledge.
branches.cn: 基础义是专门知识。

branches.en: Knowledge shows as practical skill.
branches.cn: 知识表现为实际技能。

branches.en: The person's quality becomes an adjective.
branches.cn: 人的特质转为形容词。

branches.en: Knowledge and skill reinforce each other.
branches.cn: 知识与技能相互支撑。

branches.en: A specialist gives expert advice.
branches.cn: 专家提供专业建议。

intro.en: Expert comes from the Latin participle expertus.
intro.cn: expert 来自拉丁语分词 expertus。

latinIntro.en: Latin experiri and expertus supply the core forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 experiri 与 expertus 提供核心词形。

definition_en: to make something clear; to give a reason for something; to account for a decision or action
core_image: 把褶皱的东西摊平，让人一眼看清
scene: 老师耐心地解释了这条语法规则。The teacher patiently explained the grammar rule.
sceneCN: 这里 explain 是「解释」（第 1 个义项）；句意：老师耐心地解释了这条语法规则。

senses.title: Make clear
senses.definition: to make something clear or easy to understand
senses.definitionCN: 使某事清楚、容易理解
senses.example: Could you explain the rule again?
senses.exampleCN: 你能再解释一遍这条规则吗？
senses.why: The core sense is making something flat and clear.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是把事情摊平、讲清楚。

senses.title: Give a reason
senses.definition: to give a reason for something
senses.definitionCN: 为某事给出原因
senses.example: He explained why he was late.
senses.exampleCN: 他解释了自己迟到的原因。
senses.why: Making clear includes showing the cause.
senses.whyCN: 讲清楚也包括说明原因。

senses.title: Account for
senses.definition: to account for a decision or defend an action
senses.definitionCN: 说明某项决定的理由或为行为辩解
senses.example: She explained her decision to the board.
senses.exampleCN: 她向董事会说明了她的决定。
senses.why: Explaining becomes answering for a choice.
senses.whyCN: 解释变成为自己的选择作交代。

intro.en: Explain comes from Latin explanare, to make flat and clear.
intro.cn: explain 源自拉丁语 explanare，意为「摊平、使清楚」。

items.en: Planus means flat or clear.
items.cn: planus 意为平坦、清楚。

items.en: Explanare means to flatten out.
items.cn: explanare 意为把东西摊平。

items.en: Explainer keeps the sense of unfolding.
items.cn: explainer 保留「展开」的含义。

items.en: Explanen means to make plain.
items.cn: explinen 意为使明白。

items.en: Explain adds the sense of giving reasons.
items.cn: explain 增加了「说明原因」之义。

items.en: Explain yourself means to justify your action.
items.cn: explain yourself 意为为自己的行为辩解。

note.en: Explain means make clear; exclaim means cry out.
note.cn: explain 是把事情讲清楚，exclaim 则是大声喊出。

entries.definition: to make something easier to understand
to say what something is like
to explain the meaning of something

normalIntro.en: Explain is about laying an idea out flat and clear.
normalIntro.cn: explain 就是把一个想法摊平、讲清楚。

normal.en: The guide explained how the machine works.
normal.cn: 向导讲解了这台机器如何运转。

normal.en: Please explain why the train is late.
normal.cn: 请说明火车晚点的原因。

normal.en: He explained the map to the visitors.
normal.cn: 他给游客讲解了地图。

normal.en: She explained herself calmly to the manager.
normal.cn: 她冷静地向经理说明了自己的做法。

normal.en: The book explains the idea in simple words.
normal.cn: 这本书用简单的语言解释了这个概念。

abstract.en: Picture a crumpled map smoothed on a table.
abstract.cn: 想象一张皱地图在桌上被抚平。

abstract.en: Imagine a knot slowly coming loose.
abstract.cn: 想象一个结慢慢被解开。

abstract.en: Think of fog lifting from a road.
abstract.cn: 想象路上的雾逐渐散去。

examples.en: The engineer explained the fault to the crew.
examples.cn: 工程师向机组解释了故障原因。

examples.en: Nothing could explain the sudden silence.
examples.cn: 没有什么能解释那阵突如其来的沉默。

examples.en: She explained that the office was closed.
examples.cn: 她说明办公室已经关门了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「explain」里有 plain（平白、清楚）：把事情说得平平白白，就是「解释」。

root: 拉丁语 explanare 由 ex-（向外）与 planus（平的）构成，核心义「摊平、使一目了然」。

sensesIntro.en: Explain means to make something clear, give a reason, or account for a choice.
sensesIntro.cn: explain 意为讲清楚某事、说明原因，或为自己的选择作交代。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: flattening something so it can be seen.
core.cn: 核心意象：把东西摊平以便看清。

branches.en: The base sense is making something clear.
branches.cn: 基础义是把事情讲清楚。

branches.en: Clarity includes showing the cause.
branches.cn: 清楚也包括说明原因。

branches.en: Explaining becomes defending a choice.
branches.cn: 解释变成为自己的选择辩护。

branches.en: Meaning and cause are both made plain.
branches.cn: 含义与原因都被讲明白。

branches.en: Giving reasons and justifying overlap.
branches.cn: 说明原因与辩解相互重叠。

intro.en: Explain comes from Latin explanare, to flatten out.

definition_en: a statement that makes something clear; a reason given for something; an account of how something works
core_image: 把复杂的东西摊开，一件件讲明白
scene: 他的解释没有消除大家的疑问。His explanation did not remove everyone's doubt.
sceneCN: 这里 explanation 是「解释、说明」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他的解释没有消除大家的疑问。

senses.title: Statement of clarity
senses.definition: a statement that makes something clear
senses.definitionCN: 使某事变得清楚的说明
senses.example: Her explanation was easy to follow.
senses.exampleCN: 她的解释很容易理解。
senses.why: The noun names the act of making clear.
senses.whyCN: 名词形式指把事讲清楚这件事。

senses.title: Reason given
senses.definition: a reason given for something that happened
senses.definitionCN: 为已发生之事给出的原因
senses.example: There is no explanation for the delay.
senses.exampleCN: 这次延误没有任何解释。
senses.why: Making clear turns into giving a cause.
senses.whyCN: 讲清楚转化为给出原因。

senses.title: Account of how
senses.definition: an account of how something works
senses.definitionCN: 对某事物运作方式的说明
senses.example: The manual gives an explanation of each symbol.
senses.exampleCN: 手册对每个符号都作了解释。
senses.why: The reason extends to a full account.
senses.whyCN: 原因扩展到完整的说明。

items.en: Planus means flat or clear.

items.en: Explanacioun enters as a learned word.

items.en: Explanation covers reasons as well as clarity.

definition_en: to burst with great force; to show strong emotion suddenly; to increase very quickly
core_image: 封闭的东西突然炸开，碎片四散
scene: 旧锅炉在深夜突然爆炸。The old boiler exploded suddenly late at night.
sceneCN: 这里 explode 是「爆炸」（第 1 个义项）；句意：旧锅炉在深夜突然爆炸。

senses.title: Burst with force
senses.definition: to burst with great force and noise
senses.definitionCN: 伴随巨大力量和声响炸开
senses.example: The gas tank exploded without warning.
senses.exampleCN: 气罐毫无征兆地爆炸了。
senses.why: The core sense is a violent burst.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是猛烈的炸开。

senses.title: Burst with emotion
senses.definition: to show strong emotion suddenly
senses.definitionCN: 突然表现出强烈情绪
senses.example: She exploded with anger at the news.
senses.exampleCN: 听到这个消息，她勃然大怒。
senses.why: A physical burst becomes an emotional one.
senses.whyCN: 物理上的炸开变成情绪上的爆发。

senses.title: Grow very fast

senses.definitionCN: 非常迅速地增长
senses.example: The city's population exploded after the war.
senses.exampleCN: 战后这座城市的人口激增。
senses.why: Sudden bursting becomes sudden growth.
senses.whyCN: 突然炸开变成突然增长。

definition_en: to use something fully and well; to treat someone unfairly for gain; to develop a resource; a bold or remarkable deed
core_image: 把一份力量或资源使劲用出来
scene: 公司被指控剥削外来工人。The company was accused of exploiting migrant workers.
sceneCN: 这里 exploit 是「剥削」（第 2 个义项）；句意：公司被指控剥削外来工人。

senses.title: Use well
senses.definition: to use something fully and well
senses.definitionCN: 充分而有效地利用某物
senses.example: We should exploit solar energy in this region.
senses.exampleCN: 我们应当在这个地区利用太阳能。
senses.why: The base sense is putting power to use.
senses.whyCN: 基础义是把力量用起来。

senses.title: Take unfair advantage
senses.definition: to treat someone unfairly for your own gain
senses.definitionCN: 为了自身利益不公正地对待他人
senses.example: The factory exploited young workers.
senses.exampleCN: 这家工厂剥削年轻工人。
senses.why: Using turns into using people unfairly.
senses.whyCN: 「利用」变成不公正地利用人。

senses.title: Develop a resource
senses.definition: to develop a natural resource for use
senses.definitionCN: 开发自然资源以供使用
senses.example: The country began to exploit its oil fields.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家开始开发其油田。
senses.why: Using extends to large-scale resource work.
senses.whyCN: 利用扩展到大规模的资源开发。

senses.title: Bold deed
senses.definition: a bold or remarkable act
senses.definitionCN: 大胆而出色的行为
senses.example: The sailor told stories of his exploits at sea.
senses.exampleCN: 那位水手讲述他海上的英勇事迹。
senses.why: The noun keeps the old sense of an achievement.
senses.whyCN: 名词保留了「成就」的古老含义。

intro.en: Exploit comes from Old French esploit, an achievement or success.
intro.cn: exploit 源自古法语 esploit，意为「成就、成功」。

items.en: Explicare means to unfold or set out.
items.cn: explicare 意为展开、铺陈。

items.en: Esploit means a success or bold deed.
items.cn: esploit 意为成功或英勇事迹。

items.en: Exploit first names a remarkable act.
items.cn: exploit 最初指非凡之举。

items.en: The verb exploit means to put to use.
items.cn: 动词 exploit 表示加以利用。

items.en: Exploit gains the negative sense of unfair use.
items.cn: exploit 获得「不公正利用」的负面含义。

note.en: Exploit is to use or take advantage; explore is to search.
note.cn: exploit 是利用或榨取，explore 则是探索。

entries.definition: to control and use a force

normalIntro.en: Exploit can mean use well, use badly, or a daring deed.
normalIntro.cn: exploit 既可指善加利用，也可指不正当地榨取，还可指英勇事迹。

normal.en: The farm exploits every hour of sunlight.
normal.cn: 这座农场充分利用每一小时阳光。

normal.en: Some employers exploit workers who lack papers.
normal.cn: 有些雇主剥削没有证件的工人。

normal.en: The firm plans to exploit the new oil field.
normal.cn: 公司计划开发新油田。

normal.en: She exploited her chance to study abroad.
normal.cn: 她抓住了出国留学的机会。

normal.en: The book tells of the explorer's exploits.
normal.cn: 这本书讲述了这位探险家的功绩。

abstract.en: Picture a tool used until it is worn thin.
abstract.cn: 想象一件工具被用到磨损。

abstract.en: Imagine a strong hand pressing down on someone.
abstract.cn: 想象一只强手向下压住别人。

abstract.en: Think of a medal won by a daring act.
abstract.cn: 想象一枚因英勇行为获得的奖章。

examples.en: The team exploited a weakness in the defense.
examples.cn: 这支队伍利用了防守中的弱点。

examples.en: Children should not be exploited for cheap labor.
examples.cn: 不应利用童工获取廉价劳动力。

examples.en: His exploits during the rescue won him a medal.
examples.cn: 他在救援中的英勇事迹为他赢得了一枚奖章。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「exploit」联想 ex（出）+ ploit（用）：把别人的价值使劲用出来，就是「利用、剥削」。

root: 源自古法语 esploit（成就、事迹），可追溯到拉丁语 explicare（展开），核心义从「做成大事」演变为「加以利用」。

sensesIntro.en: Exploit means to use well, to take unfair advantage, to develop a resource, or a bold deed.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: putting a force or person to full use.

branches.en: The base verb sense is using something well.

branches.en: Using people becomes unfair exploitation.
branches.cn: 利用人变成不公正的剥削。

branches.en: Using extends to developing resources.
branches.cn: 利用扩展到资源开发。

branches.en: The noun keeps the old sense of a bold deed.
branches.cn: 名词保留「英勇事迹」的旧义。

intro.en: Exploit comes through Old French from Latin explicare.

definition_en: to travel through a place to learn about it; to examine an idea carefully; to search for possibilities
core_image: 走进陌生的地方，一路查看、一路发现
scene: 他们花了一周时间探索这片森林。They spent a week exploring the forest.
sceneCN: 这里 explore 是「探索」（第 1 个义项）；句意：他们花了一周时间探索这片森林。

senses.title: Travel to learn
senses.definition: to travel through a place to learn about it
senses.definitionCN: 穿行某地以了解它
senses.example: They explored the cave by torchlight.
senses.exampleCN: 他们借着火把的光探索洞穴。
senses.why: The core sense is searching a new place.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是搜寻新地方。

senses.title: Examine an idea
senses.definition: to examine an idea or subject carefully
senses.definitionCN: 仔细考察一个想法或主题
senses.example: The book explores the causes of war.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书探讨战争的起因。
senses.why: Searching land becomes searching ideas.
senses.whyCN: 搜寻土地变成搜寻想法。

senses.title: Search possibilities
senses.definition: to search for possibilities or choices
senses.definitionCN: 寻找可能性或选择
senses.example: She explored several career options.
senses.exampleCN: 她研究了几种职业选择。
senses.why: Exploring becomes testing what could work.
senses.whyCN: 探索变成试探哪些可行。

items.en: Exploren means to examine a place.

items.en: Explore extends to ideas and choices.

normal.en: We should explore other ways to save energy.

normal.en: Divers explored the sunken ship.

normal.en: She explored the city on foot for hours.

abstract.en: Imagine a finger tracing a path on a map.

abstract.en: Think of many doors opening one by one.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇扇门依次打开。

examples.en: Scientists continue to explore the deep ocean.
examples.cn: 科学家继续探索深海。

examples.en: The essay explores the meaning of home.
examples.cn: 这篇文章探讨「家」的意义。

examples.en: They explored every option before deciding.
examples.cn: 做决定前他们研究了每一种选择。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: moving through a strange place to learn.

branches.en: Searching becomes testing possibilities.

definition_en: a sudden violent burst; a sudden outbreak of strong emotion; a rapid increase
core_image: 封闭之物炸开的一声巨响
scene: 一声爆炸震碎了整条街的玻璃。The explosion shattered glass along the whole street.
sceneCN: 这里 explosion 是「爆炸」（第 1 个义项）；句意：一声爆炸震碎了整条街的玻璃。

senses.title: Violent burst
senses.definition: a sudden violent burst of energy or sound
senses.definitionCN: 能量或声响的突然猛烈爆发
senses.example: The explosion broke every window.
senses.exampleCN: 爆炸震碎了每一扇窗户。
senses.why: The core sense is a violent burst.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是猛烈的炸开。

senses.title: Outburst of feeling
senses.definition: a sudden outbreak of strong emotion
senses.definitionCN: 强烈情绪的突然发作
senses.example: His explosion of anger surprised us.
senses.exampleCN: 他怒火的爆发让我们很吃惊。
senses.why: A physical burst becomes emotional.
senses.whyCN: 物理爆炸变成情绪爆发。

senses.title: Rapid increase
senses.definition: a very fast increase in number or amount
senses.definitionCN: 数量或金额的飞速增长
senses.example: The explosion in online shopping changed retail.
senses.exampleCN: 网购的激增改变了零售业。
senses.why: A burst becomes sudden growth.
senses.whyCN: 炸开变成突然增长。

intro.en: Explosion comes from Latin explosio, a driving off by clapping.
intro.cn: explosion 源自拉丁语 explosio，意为「拍手轰走」。

items.en: Explodere joins ex- (out) with plaudere (to clap).
items.cn: explodere 由 ex-（向外）与 plaudere（拍手）构成。

items.en: Explosio names the act of driving off.
items.cn: explosio 指轰走的动作。

items.en: Explosion first means a hissing off stage.
items.cn: explosion 最初指用嘘声赶下台。

items.en: Explosion also describes rapid growth.

normal.cn: 整个山谷都能听到那声爆炸。

normal.cn: 她突然大哭，让满屋人震惊。

normal.en: The population explosion changed the city.
normal.cn: 人口激增改变了这座城市。

normal.en: Experts blamed a gas leak for the explosion.
normal.cn: 专家将爆炸归咎于燃气泄漏。

normal.en: There was an explosion of interest in the course.
normal.cn: 人们对这门课的兴趣骤然高涨。

abstract.en: Picture a silent room split by one loud bang.
abstract.cn: 想象安静的房间被一声巨响撕开。

abstract.en: Imagine sparks flying outward in every direction.
abstract.cn: 想象火花向四面八方飞散。

abstract.en: Think of a graph line shooting straight up.
abstract.cn: 想象图表上的线直冲向上。

examples.cn: 爆炸损坏了旧厂房的屋顶。

examples.en: His explosion of temper ended the meeting.
examples.cn: 他暴怒发作，会议就此结束。

examples.en: The city saw an explosion of new restaurants.
examples.cn: 这座城市的新餐厅数量激增。
